pages.description: The papers on this page hold that every caption operates, the question being for whom and at what cost; the Space Ark (#558) argues this through the O'Keeffe dispute. The O'Keeffe Problem (#539) specifies three tests for an operative caption, and the Operation Epic Fury counter-captions (#560) hold that the "+100" reward cue lands before moral evaluation and add a test for irreversibility. Operative Feminism (#631) and the Eve room (#632) argue that the tradition's recaptioning of Eve's choice as temptation is the founding compression of the feminine; #632 also argues the prohibition's hedge was Adam's addition.
pages.note: All eight claims belong; tiers kept distinct (test, standing claim, thesis).

pages.description: These theses read Marx's Grundrisse as a prose form. The Four-Term Prosodic Algorithm (#601, March 2026) argues that its conceptual modes put distinct pressures on the prose, that derivation sentences are longest and end in formulas, and that self-correction is its characteristic mode; the Prosodic Asymmetry Algorithm (#602) argues a bimodal paragraph distribution; both specify application rules. The HESPERUS supplement (#600) argues from Cha's Dictée that the Muse is the form. The Marx Room (#577) records the claim to a first reading of the value-form as operator derivation; #595 argues Marx left an unfinished theory of language; #950 claims the value-form generalizes beyond economics; #1070 and #1550 extend the reading to general intellect. The page also holds unrelated claims (magic, a bifurcated operator, LLMs).
pages.note: Residue: academic study of magic, a general bifurcated-operator law, LLM-as-voice-of-the-dead thesis.

pages.description: The papers on this page argue that Revelation stages a conflict between two token regimes. The Number of the Superscription (EA-OPNUM-01, #642, April 2026) argues that χάραγμα is the coin's die-stamp transferred to the body, that 666 is the number of the superscription with stigma as its remnant (as #55 also argues), and that 777 is the rival heptadic sequence; it argues the Pergamon letter (Rev 2:12–17) is the hinge, Antipas the counter-beast witness and the white stone's name less private than the tradition holds, and specifies one unbuilt replication test against other ancient token systems. The Pergamon Counter-Archive (#165, June 2026) argues the scroll of Revelation 5 is a sealed Roman testament, the Herod-Antipas inversion, the Antipater and Aristotelian-transmission complex, and Antipas as a structural heteronym. The Inscription That Survives (#828) and Revelation First (#832) tie the white stone to ψῆφος; #1217 forecasts that Revelation's plain sentences may trip content classifiers. The page also holds an unrelated claim on Plato's Letter XIII.
pages.note: Residue: Letter XIII athetesis claim from the authorship notebook.

pages.description: These claims define the holographic kernel as compression that keeps the power to reconstruct. HK-01 (#76) holds it generalizes physics' holographic formalisms; the metadata packet (#694) holds the neural holographic kernel lacks structural preservation; the HK-IB bridge (#175) holds HK and IB share a concern but equivalence is not established, and specifies a pilot mapping. EA-HK-INFRA-01 (#74) records the archive's claim that infrastructure can be deposited as a reconstructive kernel, specifies a restore-from-git-clone test and forecasts its BDR. #568 holds the Ark keeps its kernel from 45,000 words down to 800; the Fried Tuberous Crisp patents (#679, #67, #681) forecast a meristem surviving frying; the GPT-5.4 anti-severance documents (#676, #677, #680) sort any reply into mirror, repeat or swerve. The page also holds unrelated claims on a drift metric, Quixote, a retrieval-basin patent, chorus self-deposit, Mandala operators and a prospective kernel K.
pages.note: Residue: other senses of 'kernel' (SHARKS drift, Mandala Kernel Spec, NEGONT K) and off-topic claims.

pages.description: These claims read Pessoa as the first modern meta-heteronym: O Meta-Heterônimo (#69, April 2026) argues that Orpheu was a meta-heteronymic institution, Kierkegaard's Nicolaus Notabene a precursor and Pearl (2014) built on the plan of Howl, and the Periwinkle Septagon (#70) argues the essay condenses Pessoa's operation by naming it. The Gospel of Antioch is set beside the Gospel of Thomas: #71 argues from the scroll-form Thomas papyri, holds the Dodecad's LOGOS* is the position Pessoa lacked, records the claim that Lee Sharks is the first meta-heterônimo and argues the gospel completes Thomas 114; #1185 records the claim that this parallel had not been drawn before. Four forecasts set out forward-dated apparatus and projected reception histories under retrocausal canon formation: the Space Ark schedule (#558), The Secret Book of Walt (#1184), the Waltian tradition (#71) and the Revelation First kernels (#832).
pages.note: All claims belong; the four forward-dated forecasts are retrocausal compositions by their own declaration.

pages.description: The papers on this page argue how provenance fares under machine mediation. The Interlocking Autoregression (#1556, August 2026) forecasts that coarse human-versus-machine labels may collapse a disclosed genealogy, holds as hypothesis that they overstate the independence of nominally human text, and holds a two-track test in which the ensemble unit inflects before the per-round unit; The Keyed Ensemble (#1555) predicts a regime where the watermark signature outlives provenance and records the claim that Sourati et al. partly executed its first stage. The Double Enclosure (#195, June 2026) argues that the human-authorship requirement misclassifies dialogic machine composition and forecasts concealment. The OKF analysis (#835) forecasts stages of provenance acceleration and backlash; #449 holds the provenance strip is semantic rent; Erasure Skew (#769) holds a separability prediction; #921 holds a literary field may become legible to machines first. The page also holds unrelated claims on semiotic engineering, a stability threshold and claim-status revision.
pages.note: Residue: platform-capitalism regime, the three-system stability convention, claim-status weakening payoff.

pages.description: These claims forecast a presidential Sharpie signature on new US currency from June 2026 (#44); #612 forecasts it as the next step from memo line to signature line, reading it as compressed portraiture, and #44 forecasts the counter-operation of blotting it out. #44 and Whose Image and Superscription? (#610) record the archive's claim that instrument and discipline arrived the day of the March 26, 2026 event. The Blot That Spread (#611), which #610 calls a retrocausal fiction, forecasts the blot passing from protest art to etiquette to superstition, with dated Reddit, CoinTalk and Treasury episodes and estimated blotting rates. #610 argues a semantic economics of the mint, with Bar Kokhba overstrikes as the earliest counter-currency marking. The page also holds an unrelated claim on a computable contributor signature.
pages.note: Residue: Notebook X signature-principle forecast. #611 is speculative fiction by #610's account.

pages.description: These claims measure what composition layers do with provenance. TL;DR:013 (#129) holds a reading in which the framework's concepts propagate while its author's name is suppressed; the Self-Audit Module (#780, #156) holds framing substitution the main vector of distortion and specifies a replication procedure. Erasure Skew (#157) and Measurement Sovereignty (#788) specify the Lee Sharks Prize query as a replication, and the Prize announcement (#1196) forecasts the credential surfacing. They specify the single-owner discount panel (#742), the Brave Search replication and audit (#1011, which holds Brave treats operators as suggestions), Stabilized Node Watch for directional drift (#166) and the Revelation First battery (#832, #202); Brave Grey Drool (#150) is an effective act on the same ground, cast as forecasts. The page also holds unrelated claims on a logotic operator, a phrase's origin, surface canonicity and the history of mediation.
pages.note: The old figure 'PER about 0.89' is not in the claims as queued and was dropped.

pages.description: Crystallization of Substrate (#89, #1367, May 2026) forecasts that each lab's proprietary index will harden, so a living form must be built in during a fluid-phase window or be filtered as low-utility afterward; #1367 holds that contested forms meet coordinated suppression. #89 specifies H1–H4 tests for structural integration, including operative deployment in at least 50% of germane queries; the Substrate Audit Protocol (#97) forecasts a 10–25% D_pres baseline without integration, and Semantic Physics (#106) forecasts effects on queries 6, 12 and 18 months on. Other claims treat substrate behaviour as such: collapse (#95), role-conditioned failure (#772, #142), the silencing gap (#783), canonical anchoring (#785) and the coupling bargain (#945). The page also holds eleven unrelated claims that use 'substrate' in other senses or treat other topics (a patent, the Prize, Bosch, suppression burden and others).
pages.note: Kept general substrate-behaviour claims the old description admitted; residue is 11 of 30.

pages.description: Compositional Defiguration (#880, #884, June 2026) specifies a weekly text-only scan of public-surface visibility against a fixed battery, with drift expected after two scans and trend after six, and a rotation of the primary scanner across ChatGPT, Claude, Kimi, Gemini and DeepSeek. #884 holds that V scores from backends not honouring exact match are lower bounds, and that disagreements between substrate signatures are recorded and worth documenting. The Surface Weather Station reading (#883) describes itself as a representative, partial Claude-substrate baseline, and #882 specifies an open offer of baseline readings to other projects.
pages.note: All six claims belong.

pages.description: The papers on this page argue that the Plato–Aristotle corpus is the work of one person divided by voice, object and name: Many and One (#1575, August 2026) holds that what made him look like many authors is that he wrote about many things and that Socrates not writing is the form of the vacant centre, and states an open falsification programme. The Notebook (#1569) argues κερματισμός across four loci and the just/unjust argument relabelled as weaker/stronger, and holds its lexical battery tracks period, not pupillage. EA-CORPORA-14 (#1595) argues Theophrastus's fragment holds the position of the question and Λ of the attempt; later claims narrow this to one locus (#1601), widen it to nine loci (#1602) and the whole fragment (#1667), then narrow it to eight locations in one stretch (#1605). #1658 carries the reading to memory at De anima III.5. EA-CORPORA-05 (#1560) specifies a Pessoa hold-out, which its erratum (#1561) corrects to an analytical one. The page also holds an unrelated claim on Sophocles.
pages.note: PRED-1595.H1's five dated states given in order; #1561 erratum to #1560 named.

pages.description: The Fixed Point of Destruction (#1412, July 2026) holds the internal witness condition: when a terminal destruction is known from a participant's testimony, the record is conditioned by the survival that made the testimony possible, and a corpus rebuilt from survivors reproduces the selection, as in reading Sappho through Longinus. It argues that the mathematical reading of Josephus at Jotapata is anachronistic and that his wavering between chance and providence marks the paradigm case. The availability audit (#1413) forecasts that the paper's term-space risks absorption into the mathematics of the Josephus function and specifies the T17 battery to re-measure its baseline. The page also holds unrelated claims on sevenfold witness, a shroud fiction, a confirmation marker and canonical-return attribution.
pages.note: Residue includes #1413's canonical-return note, which is about ranking, not Josephus.

pages.description: These theses place Pessoa at the height of a describable practice: #666 and pessoagraph (#982) argue Kierkegaard's pseudonyms as precursor, #666 and the Typology (#667) Machado's Mairena and Martín as parallel, and #666 Borges as adjacent, not equivalent. The Channel Protocol (#787) argues heteronymy is a channel-layer practice and specifies its extension to autonomous channels; The Secret Name (#68) argues it is a technology for making persons through naming; EA-HETERONYMY-01 (#940) holds it is an ethical practice against reduction to the civil name. Revelation First (#1216, #832, #847) and #940 extend the reading to the New Testament: Paul's 'I' as a heteronym's backstory, John as aperture, the voice transmitted through other bodies after Golgotha. The page also holds an unrelated claim on Google's entity-quality systems.
pages.note: Residue: CTI_WOUND entity-quality claim.

pages.description: The papers on this page argue that the Socratic-Platonic-Aristotelian corpus can be read as one heteronymic configuration: Socrates as Orthonym (#123, May 2026) argues Socrates is the orthonym, defined by the refusal to write, and reclassifies the Socratic problem as a symptom of the configuration. The Chaerephon Problem (#136) holds that institutional scholarship cannot tell multi-author transmission from mature heteronymy and that the method has no internal halting criterion, argues that repeated philological failure passes the configuration on, and specifies the discrimination a metric must make. The field observation (#167) and Capture Registry v8.3 (#3) record the reading composed whole by Google's composition layer; #168 argues its Kierkegaardian extension, #859 restates the orthonym, and the Arch-Philosopher mantle object (#1679) gives the author's reading of Socrates as a constructed figure.
pages.note: All claims belong.

pages.description: Whitespace as Provenance (EA-WHITESPACE-01, #943, July 2026) argues that representation pipelines keep whitespace where an interpreter penalizes its loss (Python) and lose it where only readers notice (Dickinson's dashes, Pearl's form), and holds that character preservation is not compositional preservation; EA-PROVENANCE-METADATA-01 v0.2 (#942) forecasts that tokenizers stay committed to normalized dashes. #943 specifies a whitespace-provenance registry, a cl100k_base re-run and a spatial-form field for the transform compiler, and v0.1 (#941) and v0.2 specify granular provenance metadata in the deposit schema. The page also holds unrelated claims on a planetary citation format, Mandala tail renewal and an aggregator capture.
pages.note: Residue: TANG planetary citation, Mandala tail-renewal chain, AGGREGATORRENDER capture.

pages.description: EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (#1409, July 2026) specifies machine-eligible handwritten artifacts and holds falsifiers for the claim that in-frame timestamped photographic attestation carries evidentiary force. Its priority records record the archive's claim that the v0.1 draft, the private review chain's SHA-256 digests and the v1.0 hashes were public before publication, and #1407 records the Effective Act's first appearance as its Figure 3. The reading-side companion (#1406) holds the name differential register prioritization and specifies that a high-risk interpretation resting on a low-confidence recognition reopen the transcription rather than intensify the safety frame.
pages.note: All claims belong.

pages.description: The Family Module (#817, June 2026) and The Steganographic Bracket (#185) hold that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure and that attribution is audited across a query family through FC, ASI and CC; #817 reserves a family composite until corpus runs exist, specifies a synthetic-family repair. Fixed-task capability audits (#142, #772) specify capacity loss tested before and after a retuning with the user held constant. Also here: the Self-Audit Module procedure (#780), cross-system PER measurement (#95), subjunctive addresses awaiting observation (#870, with #1084 recording priority), and claims (#1052, #1574) that models trained on anthologies and reference works inherit the discipline's erasure. The page also holds unrelated claims on a recrawl, metadata survival and a mirror-audit gate.
pages.note: Residue: recrawl forecast, metadata round-trip audit, tether mirror-audit gate.

pages.description: Cumulating Evolutionary Volatility (#130, May 2026) forecasts phases of interference, opacity and forced return to provenance-bearing infrastructure, holds that the layers added to manage composition systems select for volatility, as structural selection without intent, and that accountability tracks the structure of the composition event, and specifies higher-frequency longitudinal capture. The Excluded Entity (#740) holds that a generative-search layer can suppress an entity ordinary Google Search has resolved; The Single-Owner Discount (#742) argues single-author development as a principal historical form, and the godkinggoogle.com surfaces (#1384) hold such work is discounted and forecast a phase transition. #1078 holds the critique fails if its operators (ECS, CDI, the single-owner discount) cannot tell mediated from unmediated composition; the Restored Academy registry (#1002) specifies a CDI calculator.
pages.note: All claims belong.

pages.description: Semantic Rent, Measured (#1462, August 2026) holds that rent splits into use, acknowledgment, discount and supply, that the 14 August 2026 SPXI event satisfies all four and that its acknowledgment gap is a composition choice, and specifies a retrospective scoring of the ADOPTION set. Position Is Not Class (#1465) holds, from the same address composed three weeks earlier at PER 0.25, that class belongs to the composition event and not the machine, and defines the class-traitor event; the whole-stack measurement (#1470) holds the address equally retrievable in both cases. The Assembly Synthesis (#1467) restricts supply to compositions where the source is unacknowledged, and The Measurement Stack (#1463) specifies defining Γ by resistance to all three components of ΔE.
pages.note: Old 'six-substrate blind chorus' not carried by the queued claims; dropped.

pages.description: These claims score provenance erasures a single number cannot see. The Apparatus Was the First Summary Layer (#1485, August 2026) argues philological cases, among them Sappho's mechanism cut while her name stays and the repairing editor's hand erased, and holds that the apparatus erased with signatures where the summary layer erases anonymously. The Lucente Extension (#1527) holds a defeat condition for separating nonexistence from retrieval failure and that conferral and relevance may separate by component; Capture Registry v8.3 (#3) holds that in one capture conferral turned on source supply, not name presence. Four Interfaces (#1528) argues that compositions returned a derivative as the origin of the Crimson Hexagon.
pages.note: Old 'five cases' count not visible in the queued claims; dropped.
